summary.text: Amy Thompson is a Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 119 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running "to give every voter a choice and a voice."

paragraphs.text: Amy Thompson was born in Albert Lea, Minnesota, and graduated from Lake Mills High School.

She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa in 1991 and a graduate degree from the University of Missouri-St. Louis in 2001, and her career experience includes working as an educator.
Thompson was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024, when incumbent Republican Brad Banderman defeated her in the November 5 general election.
In 2026 she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4 and faces Banderman in the general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said tax dollars allocated for education should be used only for public schools, that access to health care is a right, and that she wants wealthy residents to pay their fair share of taxes.
